name: Lumi Finance LUAUSD
oneLiner: LUAUSD is Lumi Finance's nonstandard dollar reference token on Arbitrum, tied to LUA floor-price mechanics rather than 1:1 fiat redemption.
collateral: Over-collateralized by LUA staked at the protocol floor price, plus a diversified stablecoin reserve of USDT and USDC held as protocol-owned liquidity (including Lumi's Curve pool)
pegMechanism: Lumi's AMO (Algorithmic Market Operations) Protocol mints or redeems LUAUSD to rebalance its Curve pool toward the dollar, with the stablecoin reserve and rising LUA floor price as backing; it is not a hard 1:1 redeemable fiat stablecoin and has traded persistently below $1

oracleRisk.summary: LUAUSD is minted by users staking LUA against Lumi's internal floor-price mechanism; the reviewed material does not establish the position-level collateral checks or liquidation path.

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: The verified UtilityToken source exposes owner mint authority and allowance-based burnFrom, but no direct holder freeze, blacklist, pause, seize, or arbitrary burn function. Lumi's protocol materials and the reviewed reserve metadata describe stablecoin collateral, so FreezeWatch retains inherited upstream exposure while keeping the token-level direct-control finding conservative.
blacklistabilityReview.reviewer: SONG Safety Score V9 access review

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: LUAUSD has one tracked Arbitrum contract and no token-specific bridge controls in reviewed issuer docs. The Arbitrum signal is canonical chain infrastructure, not a separate stablecoin route.

reserves.name: LUA floor-price collateral, protocol-owned liquidity, and stablecoin reserves
reserves.issuerOrObligor: Lumi Finance protocol (LUA bonding-curve reserve, protocol-owned USDT/USDC liquidity, and Lumi's Curve pool)

reserveReview.reviewer: Kimi P2 reserve cohort rc-8 (lead rwausdi-multipli)
reserveReview.rationale: Lumi documents LUAUSD as over-collateralized by LUA staked at the protocol floor price plus a diversified USDT/USDC protocol-owned liquidity reserve; the split between LUA collateral and stablecoin POL is not published as a dated figure, so one bounded basket is retained with the governance-token support driving the very-high risk tier.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Lumi Finance documented backing model; current split between LUA collateral and stablecoin protocol-owned liquidity undisclosed
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The current split between LUA floor-price collateral, USDT/USDC protocol-owned liquidity, and Curve pool positions is not published as a dated aggregate.

nonLinkDispositions.reserveName: LUA floor-price collateral, protocol-owned liquidity, and stablecoin reserves
nonLinkDispositions.rationale: Both documented constituents are known but no current weights are published, so stablecoin dependency edges cannot be weighted.

providers.name: Lumi Finance protocol contracts (Arbitrum: bonding curve, AMO, and protocol-owned liquidity)

custodyProfile.reviewer: Kimi P2 reserve cohort rc-8 (lead rwausdi-multipli)
custodyProfile.uncertainty: Backing assets sit in Lumi's on-chain protocol contracts (bonding-curve reserve, AMO, and Curve pool liquidity) rather than with a disclosed custodian; segregation, bankruptcy remoteness, and reuse terms are not documented.

notices.title: Nonstandard stable reference
notices.message: LUAUSD is included because providers classify it as a dollar asset, but its mechanics are closer to a floor-price synthetic than a hard 1:1 redemption token.
